simple.meaning: בָּדַק (bâdaq) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to mend a breach.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in 2 Chronicles, beginning at 2 Chronicles 34:10. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּדַק (H918) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בָּדַק (bâdaq) / H918 is traced through 2 Chronicles 34:10 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: They delivered it into the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and the workmen who labored in Yahweh’s house gave it to mend and repair the house.
